map.输入压力-流率测定参数，计算 BOOI（梗阻指数）与 BCI（收缩指数）: Enter pressure-flow study parameters to calculate BOOI (obstruction index) and BCI (contractility index)
map.最大尿流率时逼尿肌压 Pdet@Qmax（cmH₂O）: Detrusor pressure at maximum flow Pdet@Qmax (cmH2O)
map.初始尿意容量（mL，可选）: Volume at first desire to void (mL, optional)
map.BOOI 膀胱出口梗阻指数分级（男性）: BOOI bladder outlet obstruction index grading (men)
map.BOOI 用于评估男性膀胱出口梗阻（BPH等）；BCI 评估逼尿肌收缩力。\n:
BOOI assesses bladder outlet obstruction in men (BPH and others); BCI assesses detrusor contractility.
Obstruction plus normal contractility means relieving the obstruction works well; obstruction plus weak contractility (DUA) means the improvement in voiding after surgery is limited, so surgery requires caution.
DO and reduced compliance suggest a possible neurogenic bladder.
map.⚠️ 本工具基于压力-流率测定，仅供临床参考，完整尿动力学解读需医师综合判断。: ⚠️ This tool is based on pressure-flow studies and is for clinical reference only; full urodynamic interpretation requires the physician's comprehensive judgment.
map.Pdet@Qmax=70、Qmax=15：BOOI=70−2×15=40>40: Pdet@Qmax=70, Qmax=15: BOOI = 70 - 2 x 15 = 40 > 40 suggests bladder outlet obstruction; BCI = 70 + 5 x 15 = 145, normal contractility.
map.Pdet=40、Qmax=10：BOOI=40−20=20（临界），BCI=90: Pdet=40, Qmax=10: BOOI = 40 - 20 = 20 (borderline), BCI = 90, suggesting possible obstruction or weak contractility; imaging correlation is needed.
map.BOOI>40 梗阻、<40 无梗阻（20-40 临界需结合）；BCI>100: BOOI >40 means obstruction, <40 means no obstruction (20-40 is borderline and needs correlation); BCI >100 means normal contraction, <100 means weak contraction.
map.做尿动力学检查前要注意什么？: What should be noted before a urodynamic study?
map.通常需按医嘱停用影响排尿的药物（α 受体阻滞剂、抗胆碱药、利尿剂等）并在检查前排: Usually drugs that affect voiding (alpha-blockers, anticholinergics, diuretics and others) must be stopped as instructed and the rectum emptied beforehand; during the study stay as close to natural voiding as possible and avoid excessive tension, otherwise distorted Pdet and Qmax will directly cause BOOI misjudgment.
